heading: Repealed. Pub. L. 88–426, title III, § 305(36), Aug. 14, 1964, 78 Stat. 427

notes.text: Section, Pub. L. 87–330, title II, § 200, Sept. 30, 1961, 75 Stat. 728, prescribed the compensation of the Administrator, Bonneville Power Administration, and is prescribed by section 5316 of Title 5, Government Organization and Employees.

notes.heading: Effective Date of Repeal
notes.text: Repeal effective on first day of first pay period which begins on or after July 1, 1964, see section 501 of Pub. L. 88–426.
